queries.sql: select count(*) as "aggregate" from (select 1 from "entities" where EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true AND el.geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(?, ?, ?, ?, 4326)) and exists (select 1 from "entity_temporal_ranges" as "etr" where "etr"."entity_id" = "entities"."entity_id" and "etr"."is_primary" = ? and int4range(etr.start_year, CASE WHEN etr.end_year IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE etr.end_year + 1 END, '[)') @> ?::integer) limit 1001) as "capped"

select "entities".*, (SELECT etr.start_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_start, (SELECT etr.end_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_end, (SELECT el.location_name FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS location_name, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS geom_geojson, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.territory_geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS territory_geom_geojson, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(et.tag ORDER BY et.tag) FROM entity_tags et WHERE et.entity_id = entities.entity_id), '[]'::json) AS entity_tags_json from "entities" where EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true AND el.geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(?, ?, ?, ?, 4326)) and exists (select 1 from "entity_temporal_ranges" as "etr" where "etr"."entity_id" = "entities"."entity_id" and "etr"."is_primary" = ? and int4range(etr.start_year, CASE WHEN etr.end_year IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE etr.end_year + 1 END, '[)') @> ?::integer) order by "impact_score" desc limit 50 offset 0

select count(*) as "aggregate" from (select 1 from "entities" where lower(name) LIKE ? limit 1001) as "capped"

select "entities".*, (SELECT etr.start_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_start, (SELECT etr.end_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_end, (SELECT el.location_name FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS location_name, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS geom_geojson, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.territory_geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS territory_geom_geojson, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(et.tag ORDER BY et.tag) FROM entity_tags et WHERE et.entity_id = entities.entity_id), '[]'::json) AS entity_tags_json from "entities" where lower(name) LIKE ? order by "impact_score" desc limit 30 offset 0
select count(*) as "aggregate" from (select 1 from "entities" where ("name"::text ILIKE ? or to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', ?)) limit 1001) as "capped"

select "entities".*, (SELECT etr.start_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_start, (SELECT etr.end_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_end, (SELECT el.location_name FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS location_name, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS geom_geojson, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.territory_geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS territory_geom_geojson, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(et.tag ORDER BY et.tag) FROM entity_tags et WHERE et.entity_id = entities.entity_id), '[]'::json) AS entity_tags_json from "entities" where ("name"::text ILIKE ? or to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', ?)) order by similarity(name, ?) DESC limit 30 offset 0
select count(*) as "aggregate" from (select 1 from "entities" where (name % ? or "name"::text ILIKE ? or to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', ?)) limit 1001) as "capped"

select "entities".*, (SELECT etr.start_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_start, (SELECT etr.end_date FROM entity_temporal_ranges etr WHERE etr.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND etr.is_primary = true ORDER BY etr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, etr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS temporal_end, (SELECT el.location_name FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS location_name, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS geom_geojson, ST_AsGeoJSON((SELECT el.territory_geom FROM entity_locations el WHERE el.entity_id = entities.entity_id AND el.is_primary = true ORDER BY el.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, el.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))::jsonb AS territory_geom_geojson, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(et.tag ORDER BY et.tag) FROM entity_tags et WHERE et.entity_id = entities.entity_id), '[]'::json) AS entity_tags_json from "entities" where (name % ? or "name"::text ILIKE ? or to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', ?)) order by similarity(name, ?) select "tags".*, (select count(*) from "chronicles" inner join "chronicle_tags" on "chronicles"."chronicle_id" = "chronicle_tags"."chronicle_id" where "tags"."slug" = "chronicle_tags"."tag" and "chronicles"."status" != ?) as "chronicles_count", (select count(*) from "entity_tags" where "entity_tags"."tag" = "tags"."slug") as "entities_count" from "tags" order by CASE facet WHEN 'era' THEN 0 WHEN 'region' THEN 1 WHEN 'theme' THEN 2 WHEN 'type' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, "sort_order" asc, "name" asc

select "entities".*, (select count(*) from "geometry_periods" where "entities"."entity_id" = "geometry_periods"."entity_id") as "geometry_periods_count", (select count(*) from "entity_timeline_entries" where "entities"."entity_id" = "entity_timeline_entries"."entity_id") as "timeline_entries_count" from "entities" where "entity_id" = ? limit 1
select * from "entity_temporal_ranges" where "is_primary" = ? and "entity_temporal_ranges"."entity_id" in (?) order by "updated_at" desc
select * from "entity_locations" where "is_primary" = ? and "entity_locations"."entity_id" in (?) order by "updated_at" desc
select "story_id", "entity_id", "chronicle_id", "slug", "kind", "title", "year", "step_count" from "map_stories" where "map_stories"."entity_id" in (?) order by "year" asc, "title" asc
